first_operational.notes: Project history places delivermail in the 4BSD-era Berkeley environment; exact release dates require original BSD-media verification.

roles: route mail across heterogeneous network/mail transports

software.version_or_revision: 4BSD/4.1BSD delivermail → 4.2BSD-era sendmail → later branches; exact source genealogy pending

operations.monitoring: Mail queues and logs expose delivery/routing state.
operations.diagnostics: Address rewriting, resolver/MX selection, transport failure and queue state must be distinguished.
operations.failure_behavior: Temporary failures queue/retry; malformed policy/routing rules can misroute or loop mail.
operations.operator_interface: sendmail configuration, queue commands, logs and aliases are major historical operator artifacts.

supports: need for more general sendmail architecture

sources.notes: Participant/project history; release details need source-media confirmation.

notes: sendmail is not SMTP itself. It is an implementation/orchestration lineage where multiple protocol and institutional histories meet.
